boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Hampden-Sydney spaces for quiet reading, computer work, tutoring, collaborative projects, presentations, and research. Confirm hours or reservations before visiting.

cards.title: Settle in at Bortz Library
cards.subtitle: Group rooms and dedicated library study space
cards.notes: Choose Bortz for sustained reading or group work; check the library’s current schedule and room availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines general study areas with 11 group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney’s 2024–25 Fact Book identifies Bortz Library and reports 11 available group-study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Library access follows the current Bortz schedule; group-room availability may vary.

cards.title: Handle Computer-Heavy Work at Fuqua
cards.subtitle: Computer lab, scanning, and printing in Bortz Library
cards.notes: Bring digital assignments here when you need a campus computer, scanner, or printer; verify current building and lab access first.
cards.short_summary: A practical workstation stop for assignments requiring campus computing equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The College states that the Fuqua Computing Center is on Bortz Library’s ground level and houses a computer lab plus scanning and printing facilities.
cards.access_notes: Located on Bortz Library’s ground level; confirm current library and computer-lab access.

cards.title: Pair Study Time with Academic Support
cards.subtitle: Bortz Library rooms 231–235
cards.notes: Bring your textbook, notes, assignment, and specific questions when seeking tutoring or structured help with a difficult course.
cards.short_summary: A named Bortz suite for tutoring, advising, and study-skills support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Academic Success is in Bortz Library rooms 231–235 and offers tutoring in multiple academic subjects without an appointment.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring schedules and staffed access vary; consult the current Office of Academic Success information.

cards.entity_name: Pannill Center for Rhetoric and Communication
cards.title: Reserve a Room at Pannill
cards.subtitle: Collaborative rooms facing Chalgrove Lake
cards.notes: Use Pannill for group drafting, interview preparation, editing, or presentation rehearsal; confirm room reservations in advance.
cards.short_summary: A communication-focused building designed around reservable collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center contains classrooms, shared central space, presentation-practice rooms, and an online reservation system for studying and collaboration.
cards.source_title: The Pannill Center for Rhetoric and Communication
cards.access_notes: Some rooms are intended for online reservation; verify current student access and booking rules.

cards.title: Workshop a Draft in the Rhetoric Studio
cards.subtitle: Writing, speaking, and digital-rhetoric support
cards.notes: Bring a draft, speech, or multimedia project and use the Studio’s collaborative setup with a consultant when schedules permit.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated learning space for improving written, spoken, and multimedia work.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the Rhetoric Studio as an interactive collaborative space combining its Writing Center, Speaking Center, and Digital Rhetoric.
cards.access_notes: Consult the Rhetoric Studio’s current hours and tutoring schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Publication Project Together
cards.subtitle: Pannill office, lounge, and shared computer lab
cards.notes: Use this Pannill workspace for publication editing or team production when authorized; confirm eligibility and room access beforehand.
cards.short_summary: A publication-oriented collaborative space with computers and a lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pannill Center page says Student Publications has an office, lounge, and shared computer lab supporting four student publications.
cards.source_title: The Pannill Center for Rhetoric and Communication
cards.access_notes: This is an organization workspace; confirm access with Student Publications or Pannill staff.

cards.title: Spread Out for STEM Work at Pauley
cards.subtitle: Interactive and open collaborative science spaces
cards.notes: Bring problem sets or a group research plan to Pauley’s collaborative areas; use laboratories only with proper course authorization.
cards.short_summary: A science building with study and collaboration space beyond its classrooms and labs.
cards.evidence_claim: The College documents interactive spaces for teaching and scholarly activity, while its science journal reports increased study spaces in Pauley.
cards.access_notes: Use open collaborative areas during authorized building access; laboratories require appropriate permission.

cards.title: Plan Group Study in the DEI Lounge
cards.subtitle: Reservable meeting space in lower Venable Hall
cards.notes: Contact the responsible campus office before using the lounge for study, then bring materials suited to its meeting-space format.
cards.short_summary: A book-lined lounge supporting both reservable group work and individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the DEI Lounge includes a Social Justice Library and meeting space usable for reserved group study or on a walk-in basis.
cards.source_title: DEI Lounge Fosters Equity and Inclusion
cards.access_notes: Students and employees are directed to contact the responsible campus office about access and current hours.

cards.title: Use Brown for Informal Group Work
cards.subtitle: Indoor and outdoor communal areas overlooking Chalgrove Pond
cards.notes: Choose Brown for conversational review or project planning, and relocate if scheduled activities make the communal areas too active.
cards.short_summary: A flexible alternative for study sessions that do not require library quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies Brown Student Center as a student hub with multiple indoor and outdoor communal areas and student-organization spaces.
cards.access_notes: Communal areas may host activities or organizations; confirm building access and yield to scheduled uses.

cards.title: Focus a Career-Planning Session at Ferguson
cards.subtitle: Career resources inside Brown Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a résumé, application, or career questions; schedule coaching for guided work or browse available resources during open access.
cards.short_summary: A focused destination for résumé work, applications, and career research.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Ferguson Career Center offers career-coaching appointments, events, and career resources in Brown Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Coaching requires scheduling; verify current office hours before planning independent resource use.

warnings: Current public pages do not provide verified coordinates for each interior destination, so card coordinates are null.
Several spaces have schedule, reservation, affiliation, or authorization constraints; users should confirm current access before visiting.
